h1: Custom 30 oz Koozies for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 30 oz koozies in bulk. Ideal for large cans and bottles. Get your logo imprinted today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When you need a koozie that fits oversized cans and bottles, custom 30 oz koozies are the answer. These larger sleeves accommodate tallboys, big bottles, and even some tumblers, providing full insulation and a generous branding area. Whether you choose neoprene or vacuum-insulated options, screen printing or debossing ensures your logo stands out. Perfect for events, promotions, or employee gifts.
heroAltText: Custom 30 oz koozies with company logo printed on neoprene sleeve for large cans and bottles.
